core_entities.name: Passenger Door Floor Lamp Control Circuit
core_entities.description: The electronic circuit responsible for controlling the floor lamp in the passenger door area.

core_conditions.name: Laser Welcome Light Driver Activation State
core_conditions.description: The state where the laser welcome light driver is activated, indicating the system is attempting to illuminate the floor lamp.

core_conditions.name: Driving Current Threshold
core_conditions.description: A predefined current value used as a reference to determine if the driving current is within acceptable limits.

core_outputs.name: Current RMS Value
core_outputs.description: The root mean square value of the current flowing through the circuit, used to assess whether it exceeds or falls below the threshold.

core_faults.name: Circuit Short to Battery
core_faults.description: A fault condition where the circuit is shorted directly to the battery, causing excessive current flow.

core_faults.name: Circuit Short to Ground
core_faults.description: A fault condition where the circuit is shorted to ground, causing abnormal current behavior.

core_faults.name: Circuit Open
core_faults.description: A fault condition where the circuit is open or disconnected, preventing normal current flow.

core_timing_constraints.name: Duration
core_timing_constraints.description: The fault condition must persist for at least 100 milliseconds to be considered valid.
